description: Search police stop and search records for one month, or with month_from a range of up to 12 months, inside an area — a point with a 1-mile radius, a polygon, a location_id from an earlier result, or a police neighbourhood — or across a whole force with area 'force', which includes stops the force could not place. Returns the total and counts by search type, self-defined and officer-defined ethnicity, outcome, object of search, legislation, age range, gender, whether the outcome was linked to the object of search, and whether more than outer clothing was removed, each month's total for a range, and a page of stops. filters narrow the counts and the page together, so filtering one field and reading another's breakdown gives a cross-tab. Forces skip months and some publish none; the result names each force it finds for the area that did not publish, with the months it skipped.

area.description: Area to search: 'point' (lat and lng; a 1-mile radius), 'polygon' (polygon), 'location' (location_id), 'neighbourhood' (force and neighbourhood_id), or 'force' (force alone: every stop the force published for the month or range, placed or not). An area field the chosen area does not use is rejected.

filters.description: Up to 8 filters, all of which a stop must match; they narrow the counts and the page together. Fields: type, self_defined_ethnicity, officer_defined_ethnicity, outcome, object_of_search, legislation, age_range, gender, outcome_linked_to_object_of_search, removal_of_more_than_outer_clothing.

items.description: Keep only stops whose field equals value.

value.description: Value to match exactly, case-insensitively, as the breakdowns show it: 'true' or 'false' for outcome_linked_to_object_of_search and removal_of_more_than_outer_clothing (a JSON true or false reads the same), and '(not recorded)' for stops with no value.

force.description: Force id such as 'leicestershire', or its name such as 'Leicestershire Police' (ukcrime_list_reference topic 'forces' lists both); case-insensitive, spaces, underscores and hyphens match each other, '&' matches 'and', and a trailing 'Police', 'Police Service' or 'Constabulary' is optional. For area 'neighbourhood' (with neighbourhood_id) and 'force' (alone), where 'btp' (British Transport Police) is also accepted.

lat.description: Latitude, WGS84 decimal degrees, for area 'point'.

lng.description: Longitude, WGS84 decimal degrees, for area 'point'.

location_id.description: For area 'location': location.location_id from an earlier result — one anonymised map point.

month.description: Month as YYYY-MM, or the last month of the range with month_from. Omitted: the latest published month, echoed as month in the result.

month_from.description: First month of a range, YYYY-MM, searched through month — up to 12 months, with a total for each in by_month. Omitted: month alone.

neighbourhood_id.description: For area 'neighbourhood', with force: a neighbourhood id from ukcrime_list_reference topic 'neighbourhoods', or from ukcrime_find_neighbourhood for a point. Case-sensitive; only trimmed.

offset.description: Rows to skip before this page; pass next_offset from the previous result. Default 0.

polygon.description: For area 'polygon': 3–2,500 vertices as { lat, lng } objects, or the string 'lat,lng:lat,lng:…'. The ring closes itself (the last vertex joins the first). [lng, lat] pairs are not accepted.

items.description: One polygon vertex as { lat, lng }.

name: ukcrime_search_stops

area.description: The area as the server searched it.

force.description: Force id, when the area names one.

located_force.description: Force covering the point, or the location's map point, when located.

located_forces.description: For 'polygon': forces its bounding-box centre and outermost vertices were located in, sorted; a point whose lookup failed adds none. Absent when none was located.

located_neighbourhood.description: Neighbourhood covering the point, or the location's map point, when located.

by_age_range.description: Matched stops by age range, most first.

by_gender.description: Matched stops by gender, most first.

by_legislation.description: Matched stops by legislation, most first.

by_month.description: Stops matched in each month of the range, oldest first; their totals sum to total. Present only when month_from was given.

force_published.description: Whether every force found for the area published stop and search this month; absent on the same terms as the top-level force_published.

total.description: Matched records in this month, after every filter.

by_object_of_search.description: Matched stops by object of search, most first.

by_officer_defined_ethnicity.description: Matched stops by ethnicity as the officer perceived it, most first.

by_outcome.description: Matched stops by outcome, most first; '(not recorded)' is often the largest.

by_outcome_linked_to_object_of_search.description: Matched stops by whether the outcome was linked to the object of search ('true', 'false' or '(not recorded)'), most first.

by_removal_of_more_than_outer_clothing.description: Matched stops by whether more than outer clothing was removed ('true', 'false' or '(not recorded)' where the force sent no value, as some do for vehicle-only searches), most first.

by_self_defined_ethnicity.description: Matched stops by ethnicity as the person defined it, most first.

by_type.description: Matched stops by search type, most first.

data_note.description: What these records can and cannot say; read it first.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_area`: the area's required fields are missing, or a field it does not use is present. `month_not_published`: month or month_from is after the latest published month. `month_out_of_range`: month or month_from is before the 36-month window. `invalid_month_range`: month_from is after month, or the range spans more than 12 months. `unknown_force`: force matches no listed force id or name, or more than one, or is 'btp' on area 'neighbourhood'. `unknown_neighbourhood`: the force has no neighbourhood with this id (ids are case-sensitive). `area_too_large`: the area holds more stops than data.police.uk will answer for. `range_too_large`: the range's months hold more records than one call keeps for a range. `range_incomplete`: the months of the range could not all be fetched within the time one call allows. `upstream_unavailable`: data.police.uk is not answering. `rate_limited`: data.police.uk is rate-limiting this server for longer than this call can wait. `pacer_shed`: too many requests to data.police.uk are already queued in this server. `retry_deadline_exceeded`: data.police.uk did not answer within the time one call allows. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

filters.description: Filters applied, case-insensitively; empty when none.

force_published.description: Whether every force found for the area (the one it names, or each located at a point, a polygon's centre and outermost vertices, or a location's map point) published stop and search this month, or in every month of a range: false when any month was missed. Otherwise absent when no force was found, when a month has no row in the publication list, or when none of those found is missing yet a polygon point could not be looked up.

month.description: The month searched, or the last month of the range, YYYY-MM.

month_from.description: First month of the range searched, YYYY-MM; present only when month_from was given.

next_offset.description: Pass as offset for the next page; absent on the last page.

notice.description: Defaulted month, coverage gaps, why a result is empty, and how to page on.

stops.description: This page of matched stops, oldest first, then by location_id.

items.description: One stop and search, values as published; a field is absent when not recorded.

datetime.description: When the stop happened, UTC ISO 8601 as published.

legislation.description: Power the search was made under.

location.description: Absent for stops the force could not place.

location_id.description: Map point id; pass it as location_id with area 'location'.

map_point.description: Anonymised point covering at least eight addresses, not where it happened. Absent when unpublished.

subtype.description: Station or premises type, when published.

type.description: 'BTP': a British Transport Police station record; 'Force': a territorial force's.

object_of_search.description: What the officer was searching for.

officer_defined_ethnicity.description: Ethnicity as the officer perceived it.

operation_name.description: Policing operation the stop was part of.

outcome_linked_to_object_of_search.description: Whether the outcome related to the object searched for.

removal_of_more_than_outer_clothing.description: Whether more than outer clothing was removed.

self_defined_ethnicity.description: Ethnicity as the person defined it.

type.description: Person search, vehicle search, or both.

total.description: Stops matched after filters, over the month or range.

truncated.description: True when more rows remain after this page.

unfiltered_total.description: Stops in the area over the month or range, before filters.

unplaced.description: Matched stops with no location — the force's unplaced stops, for area 'force'.
